[[File:Logarytmy-dla-szkol-narodowych.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Book cover of ''Logarytmy dlá szkół narodowych'', 1787.]]
'''Ignacy Zaborowski''' (2 November 1754–10 January 1803) was a Polish [[mathematician]] and [[geodesist]]; [[Piarists|Piarist]]. He was a professor and [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[Collegium Nobilium (Warsaw)|Collegium Nobilium]].

==Biography==
Born on 2 November 1754 in [[Ruthenian Voivodeship]],<ref name="geoforum">{{cite web
|title=GeoForum: GeoLudzie
|url=http://www.geoforum.pl/pages/index.php?page=geopeople&id_people_category=27
|accessdate=2007-04-23
|first=Jerzy
|last=Przywara
|language=Polish
|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927235803/http://www.geoforum.pl/pages/index.php?page=geopeople&id_people_category=27
|archive-date=2007-09-27
|url-status=dead
}}</ref> Zaborowski attended [[Piarists]] school in [[Zolochiv, Lviv Oblast|Zolochiv]]. He joined the Piarists order and after that he taught [[mathematics]] in Piarists school in [[Waręż]] and [[Łomża]]. After moving to [[Warsaw]], he became a teacher of mathematics and measuring, and then [[Rector (academia)|rector]] (1799–1801) of [[Collegium Nobilium (Warsaw)|Collegium Nobilium]]. In 1777 he went to [[Vienna]] for supplementary studies.<ref name="geoforum" />

In 1786 Zaborowski published the [[textbook]] ''Jeometria praktyczna'' ([[Polish language|Polish]] for ''Practical geometry''), where he described methods of [[geodesy|geodesic]] measurement. The book was awarded the [[Merentibus]] by [[Stanisław August Poniatowski]]. Zaborowski was an author of ''Logarytmy dlá szkół narodowych'' (Polish for ''[[Logarithm]]s for national schools'') written by order of [[Komisja Edukacji Narodowej|Commission of National Education]] and published in 1787. He also wrote ''Tablice matematyczne'' (Polish for ''[[Mathematical table]]s'') which was published in 1797. He translated Fulgenty Obermajer's ''Arytmetyka praktyczna kieszonkowa''. He started working on the book ''Geometria wiejska'', an agriculture measurement textbook, but it has not been finished.<ref name="geoforum" />

In 1800 he became a member of the [[Warsaw Society of Friends of Learning|Society of Friends of Science]]. Since 1802 he was a [[Provincial superior|provincial]] of [[Piarists]].

Zaborowski died on 10 January 1803 in [[Warsaw]].

==Works==
Books:
* ''Jeometria praktyczna'' (1786)
* ''Logarytmy dlá szkół narodowych'' (1787)
* ''Tablice matematyczne'' (1797)
* ''Geometria wiejska'' (never finished)

Translations:
* Obermajer, Fulgenty. ''Arytmetyka praktyczna kieszonkowa, Porywcze codzienne trafiające się rachunki, przy redukcyach monet, przy kupi i przedaży, z wielką łatwością odprawująca przez taryfę, o której na samym czele kładnie się informacya''.
